settings.nudgeBodyAccount: Manage your account, profile, and preferences.
settings.nudgeTitleSocial: Sign in to manage your social links
settings.adultContentHelp: Choose what happens when you encounter content marked as 18+.
settings.adultContentAskHelp: Show an interstitial before any adult content. You can opt in or out per session.
settings.adultContentAllowHelp: Show adult content without prompting. Confirms you are 18 or older.
settings.adultContentHideHelp: Adult content stays hidden. You'll see a placeholder where it would appear.
settings.adultImagePreviewHelp: Choose how preview images on adult discussions appear in lists.
settings.adultImagePreviewBlurHelp: Blur adult preview images. Click to reveal.
settings.adultImagePreviewHideHelp: Hide adult preview images entirely. Title and badges still show.
settings.avatarHelp: Upload a custom avatar or use the auto-generated one.
settings.avatarDropLabel: Click or drag an image here
settings.displayNameHelp: 3-20 characters. Letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, underscores.
settings.displayNamePwdHelp: Required to change your display name
settings.bioHelp: A short description that appears on your profile.
settings.bioPlaceholder: Tell others a bit about yourself...
settings.timezoneMapAria: World map — click a country to select its timezone
settings.timezoneHelp: Click a country on the map, or select directly
settings.notifAutoFollowHelp: When you post a reply, you will automatically follow that discussion and receive notifications for new replies.
settings.privDevicesHelp: Devices that have been trusted for this account. Revoking a device will require re-authentication on that device.
settings.privPasswordHelp: Change your password. You will need your current password to set a new one.
settings.socialIntro: Add links to your profiles on other platforms. Others will see these on your public profile. Maximum 10 links. Choose from the supported platforms below.
settings.browserDeviceOnly: These settings are saved in this browser only and won't sync across your devices.
settings.browserStickyHelp: Choose whether the left and right sidebars stay in view when scrolling.
settings.browserPreviewsHelp: Show a content preview when clicking the preview button on discussion cards.
settings.browserAnimationsHelp: Enable transitions and animations throughout the interface.
settings.browserSkinApplies: Applies to hand and face emojis in the editor
settings.browserEmbedsIntro: When a link discussion points to a supported source, enabling it here will automatically load the embedded content instead of showing a link card.
settings.browserEmbedsWarning: Enabling embeds allows the selected services to set cookies and track your activity through their embedded content. Only enable sources you trust.
settings.intgRssIntro: Subscribe to feeds in your favourite RSS reader. Public feeds work without a token.
settings.intgFeedsNoteBefore: Feeds are also available per hub and space — look for the RSS icon or append
settings.intgFeedsNoteAfter: to any hub or space URL.
settings.intgTokenHelp: Generate a token for authenticated feeds (e.g. your followed discussions). Keep it secret — anyone with the token can read your feeds.
settings.intgDiscordIntro: Connect your Discord account to show your Discord username on your profile.
settings.intgDiscordLinkError: Failed to connect Discord account. Please try again.

pages.spacesNewAuthPrompt: Sign in to post a discussion
pages.spacesNewStdIntro: Discussions are the standard forum thread. Your opening post starts the conversation, and others can reply.
pages.spacesNewStdWhatNext3: The thread stays active as long as people contribute
pages.spacesNewStdTip2: Format your post with headings, lists, and code blocks
pages.spacesNewStdTip3: Be respectful and follow the space rules
pages.spacesNewQuestionIntro: Questions are designed for getting answers. The community replies, and you can mark the best answer as the accepted solution.
pages.spacesNewQuestionAfter1: Others post answers in chronological order
pages.spacesNewQuestionAfter2: You can mark one answer as "accepted"
pages.spacesNewQuestionAfter3: The question shows a "Solved" badge once resolved
pages.spacesNewQuestionAfter4: Others can still reply after it's solved
pages.spacesNewQuestionWriting1: Be specific — describe the problem clearly
pages.spacesNewQuestionWriting4: Use code blocks, screenshots, or examples
pages.spacesNewPollMultipleDesc: Voters can select more than one option.
pages.spacesNewPollChangeDesc: Voters can change their vote after submitting.
pages.spacesNewPollSecretDesc: Results stay hidden until the close date. Requires a close date.
pages.spacesNewPollGroupDesc: Voters pick a group before voting. Results can be viewed by group breakdown.
pages.spacesNewPollGroupQPh: e.g. What is your experience level?
pages.spacesNewPollCloseDateDesc: Automatically close voting at a specific date and time.
pages.spacesNewPollEditorPh: Add context or details about your poll (optional)...
pages.spacesNewPollIntro: Polls let the community vote on a question. Results update in real time as votes come in.
pages.spacesNewPollAfter1: A results bar appears at the top of the discussion
pages.spacesNewPollAfter2: Members vote by clicking an option
pages.spacesNewPollAfter3: Votes are anonymous — no public voter list
pages.spacesNewPollAfter4: The poll closes automatically on the end date (if set)
pages.spacesNewPollTip1: Keep options clear and mutually exclusive
pages.spacesNewPollTip3: Use the description to provide context
pages.spacesNewPollTip4: Set an end date for time-sensitive polls
pages.spacesNewDebateEditorPh: Set the stage for the debate...
pages.spacesNewDebateIntro: Debates are structured discussions where each reply takes a position. This encourages thoughtful arguments from defined perspectives.
pages.spacesNewDebateAfter1: Your prompt and positions are shown at the top
pages.spacesNewDebateAfter2: When replying, participants must choose a position
pages.spacesNewDebateAfter3: Each reply is labeled with the author's chosen side
pages.spacesNewDebateAfter4: Readers can filter replies by position
pages.spacesNewDebateAfter5: Participants can change their position later
pages.spacesNewDebateFair1: Frame the topic as a clear question or statement
pages.spacesNewDebateFair3: Write a neutral prompt that doesn't favor one side
pages.spacesNewDebateFair4: Enable the neutral option for nuanced topics
pages.spacesNewGalleryLayoutHint: You can now choose a layout
pages.spacesNewGalleryDropHint: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP · max 5MB each · up to 20 images
pages.spacesNewGallerySpoilerDesc: Images are blurred until the viewer clicks to reveal them.
pages.spacesNewGalleryEditorPh: Add captions or context for your images...
pages.spacesNewGalleryIntro: Upload images and see a live preview in your chosen layout. Switch between grid and carousel at any time.
pages.spacesNewGalleryAfter1: Images display in your chosen layout
pages.spacesNewGalleryAfter2: Others can reply and discuss your images
pages.spacesNewGalleryTip1: Drag and drop multiple images at once
pages.spacesNewGalleryTip2: Supported: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP — max 5MB each
pages.spacesNewGuideIntro: Guides are structured how-to content that helps others learn. They're treated as semi-evergreen — meant to stay useful over time.
pages.spacesNewGuideAfter1: Your guide appears with a Guide badge
pages.spacesNewGuideAfter2: Others can ask questions and discuss in replies
pages.spacesNewGuideAfter3: You can edit and update the guide over time
pages.spacesNewGuideStruct1: Start with a summary of what the reader will learn
pages.spacesNewGuideStruct3: Use headings for steps (## Step 1, ## Step 2)
pages.spacesNewGuideStruct4: Include code examples, screenshots, or diagrams
pages.spacesNewGuideStruct5: End with a summary or next steps
pages.spacesNewIamaTitlePh: I am a ... — Ask Me Anything!
pages.spacesNewIamaVerifPh: Who are you and how can the community verify it? E.g. a link to your profile, a tweet, etc.
pages.spacesNewIamaVerifHelp: Optional. Helps moderators and the community trust the AMA is genuine.
pages.spacesNewIamaIntro: An Ask Me Anything lets the community ask you questions that you answer in real time. You are the host.
pages.spacesNewIamaHost1Html: Mark any of your replies as the official answer to a question
pages.spacesNewIamaHost2Html: Highlight up to 5 best questions after the AMA ends
pages.spacesNewIamaHost3: Close the AMA when you're done answering
pages.spacesNewIamaTip1: Use the description to introduce yourself and your topic
pages.spacesNewIamaTip2: Add a verification note so mods and the community know it's really you
pages.spacesNewIamaTip3: Schedule it in advance so the community can prepare questions early
pages.spacesNewIamaTip4: Answer the most upvoted questions first
pages.spacesNewJournalIntro: Journals are living documents. You post the first entry now, then add timestamped updates over time. Others can discuss in regular replies.
pages.spacesNewJournalAfter1: Your first post becomes the opening entry
pages.spacesNewJournalAfter2: Use "+ Add update" to append new entries
pages.spacesNewJournalAfter3: Updates appear as a timeline above the replies
pages.spacesNewJournalAfter4: Others can reply and discuss below your updates
pages.spacesNewLinkIntro: Share an interesting article, tool, or resource with the community. Add your commentary to start a discussion around it.
pages.spacesNewLinkAfter1: The link appears as a preview card at the top
pages.spacesNewLinkAfter2: Your commentary is the opening post
pages.spacesNewLinkAfter3: Others can discuss the link in replies
pages.spacesNewLinkTip1: Write a descriptive title — don't just paste the URL
pages.spacesNewLinkTip2: Share your thoughts on why the link is worth reading
pages.spacesNewLinkTip3: Check if it has been shared before
